plausibility_notes: Cyanide death after the toast strengthens scrutiny of service and victim-specific motives, but route and thief remain unknown; no clear accusation yet.
Grant's false safety claim explains delayed recognition of a dangerous theft, although securing hazardous antique contents without assessment seems institutionally questionable.
